decision: User-approved Phase 7 bounded analyzer-baseline evidence threshold artifact. Current BLW-1019 guarded coverage evidence satisfies the bounded morphology/POS coverage floors, but this approval does not approve production default analyzer/rule policy, full language-rule validation closure, or production-complete morphology/syntax corpus grounding. Language-rule validation, broader linguistic-depth grounding, Phase 7 readiness, and production-default policy blockers must still close before roadmap closure.
